title: docs(spec): onSuccess.navigate and a url target say an in-app path is an app-qualified console route (#25458)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBErsDvMNeedf4Bt2ucCK9Yt)_

Fixes #25458

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 只改说明文字。`onSuccess.navigate` 与 `type: 'url'` 动作的 `target` 现在写明：应用内路径是控制台路由，记录页是 `/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID`，APP 是应用的路由段（包 id，应用名也能解析）；规范里的示例与协议文档的示例同步改正。
- **为什么改：** 原文只说「以 `/` 开头的应用内路径」，没说要带应用段，作者照写 `/crm_opportunity/ID` 就走偏了；hotcrm#2247 裁决 C 第 2(b) 项要求把这一点写清楚，且不新增写法。
- **风险与回滚：** 零运行时风险，schema 接受与拒绝的取值完全不变，只有 describe 文本、生成的参考文档和一页手写文档变了；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`（onSuccess 文档块新增的 console route 一段，以及 `navigate` 的 describe）、`content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`（URL Actions 一节）、`.changeset/25458-navigate-console-route.md`。
- **两分钟验证：** 在本分支跑 `grep -n "console route" packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`，预期 4 处命中（target 的文档块与 describe、onSuccess 的文档块与 navigate 的 describe）。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

Wording only, on the route ruling C on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2247 ordered as item 2(b). No schema accepts or refuses anything it did not before; no new authorable form (no `${ctx.app}` member, no object-plus-record target).

- `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, `onSuccess` docblock: a new paragraph says that an in-app path is a console route, written without the console's mount prefix (`/_console` under the framework CLI). The record page is `/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID`, and the object's list is `/apps/APP/OBJECT`. `APP` is the app's route segment (ADR-0048): its package id, e.g. `app.objectstack.hotcrm`. The app's `name` resolves too, and it is the only segment that reaches an app other than the first in a package that ships several. A `./` path resolves against the current route. The contract declares no app-relative form, so write the app segment.
- Same docblock: the example `navigate: '/apps/crm/tasks/${result.id}'` becomes `'/apps/crm/tasks/record/${result.id}'`. The old one worked only through the console's shorthand redirect, which fires only when the last segment looks like a record id.
- `onSuccess.navigate` `.describe()`: the same facts in one sentence after the scheme set.
- `target` docblock and `.describe()` (the `type: 'url'` scheme set): an in-app path is a console route, and a record is `/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID`. It points to `onSuccess.navigate` for what `APP` is, so the explanation lives in one place.
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`, URL Actions: the same sentence. The example `target: /_console/dashboards/sales_overview` becomes `/apps/crm/dashboard/sales_overview`. The old one carried the mount prefix the router adds itself, and the console has no `dashboards` route at the root; the dashboard route is `dashboard/:dashboardName` under `/apps/:appName/*`.
- Regenerated with `gen:schema && gen:docs`: `content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx`, `ui/component.mdx`, `data/object.mdx` and `kernel/metadata-plugin.mdx` (the last three embed `ActionSchema`'s `target`).
- `.changeset/25458-navigate-console-route.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`.

The console's routes, quoted from `main` at `9a0108cd`:

- `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx:332`, the app mount: `Route path="/apps/:appName/*" element={AppContent}`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:1443`, the record route inside it: `Route path=":objectName/record/:recordId"`. At `:1478` is the shorthand `":objectName/:maybeRecordId"`, which redirects only when `looksLikeRecordId` holds (at least 6 URL-safe characters, not a reserved second segment).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/appRoute.ts:46`, `appRouteSegment`: the package id `_packageId`, falling back to `name`. `matchAppBySegment` matches the package id first and then the name.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 727 passed (727), Tests 22009 passed, 1 todo (22010). Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

- No ablation: the diff changes describe text and docs, not a behaviour a test pins.

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's premise is partly stale.** objectui#13379, the console half, landed when objectui moved into `ui/`. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/hostInConsolePath.ts` is wired into `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` and `RecordDetailView.tsx`. On `main` today, a rooted path whose first segment names no console route, such as `/crm_opportunity/${result.id}`, is hosted under the app the user is in. It no longer redirects Home. The wording does not promise that behaviour: the triage line and the dispatch exclude an app-relative form. The docblock names it as the console's accommodation and not a form the schema promises. The description and its example now match what the console does for the form they teach.
- The same scheme-set sentence ("an in-app path starting with / or ./") also appears outside this card's file surface and is left unchanged: `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` (`actionUrl`, ~:143/:151), `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (the empty-state link url, ~:1971) and `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (the action row's `target` and `onSuccess`, ~:4066, :4085, :4166). This is noted here and not filed as a card; carrier: none.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md:71` already writes the app-qualified record route (`/apps/crm/opportunity/record/...`). It agrees with the new text and is untouched (governed surface).
- Both docblocks still cite the console's classifier as `navigation-target.ts`. The file today is `ui/packages/core/src/actions/navigationTarget.ts`. This is a naming drift outside the wording asked for here; noted, not touched.
